name: pipeline-orchestrator
description: Automated multi-agent pipeline. v4.8.0 (Hook Enforcement): adds shared `skill-frontmatter-parser.cjs` + extends 3 hooks (sentinel-hook, dispatch-guard, force-pipeline-agents) to enforce SKILL.md frontmatter contracts (sentinel_checkpoints, agent_type per step, gates_at) for all 6 backing skills (bugfix-{light,heavy} + audit-{light,heavy} + feature-{light,heavy}). 2-phase rollout: warn mode until 2026-05-17 (logs ENFORCEMENT_WARN to gate-decisions.jsonl with hardness AUDIT, does not block); deny mode auto-promotes after (blocks via permissionDecision=deny). Override via env `PIPELINE_ENFORCEMENT={warn,deny}`. Backward compat preserved: hooks skip enforcement when state.current_skill absent (advisory mode for non-skill flows). Resolves consolidated.md §17.4 #8. v4.7.0 (Slice 3b polish): completes the v4.6.1 correction with declarative frontmatter contract on all 26 step files (execution_mode + agent_type + expected_inputs/outputs/next + gate_required), full SKILL.md manifests for feature-light + feature-heavy (sequence_lock + gates_at + sentinel_checkpoints + stop_rule_max_failures), thin entry-point `skills/feature/SKILL.md` with --light/--heavy flag handling (mirrors audit/bugfix pattern), real workflow tests replacing placeholder Pulsar TESTS_USER_STORY content (moved to `references/feature-user-story-guidelines.md`), corrected deprecated headers in `references/pipelines/implement-{heavy,light}.md`, AGENTS.md roster count fix (38 → 19), and correction headers in spec/plan docs flagging v4.6.0/v4.6.1/v4.7.0 deltas. v4.6.1 (Slice 3b correction): reverts unified single-skill-with-mode-flag pattern to 2 separate skills (feature-light + feature-heavy) mirroring Pulsar canonical Heavy/ + Ligth/ folders 1:1. Same pattern as Slice 1.5 (bugfix) + Slice 3a (audit). v4.6.0 attempted unification but was reverted per dono — fonte canônica tem 2 pastas, port deve ter 2 skills. v4.6.0 (Slice 3b initial): imports prescriptive 13-step Pulsar Implement_new_feature workflow. v4.5.0 (Slice 3a): imports prescriptive 9-step Heavy + 9-step Light audit workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (audit-light, audit-heavy); /audit dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; report-only by Iron Law (no production writes); reuses existing audit-{intake,domain-analyzer,compliance-checker,risk-matrix-generator} agents; 8 enforcement rules + read-only invariant. v4.4.1 fix: deterministic Node wrapper for exec-window (scripts/exec-window/{open,close}.cjs) eliminates PIPELINE_LOCK_ACTIVE stalls. v4.4.0 (Slice 1.5): imports prescriptive 11-step Heavy + 8-step Light bugfix workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (bugfix-light, bugfix-heavy); /bugfix dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; closes 6 audit gaps (Heavy 3+9+11, Light 3+5+6) with 8 enforcement rules. v4.3.1 polish: review-driven cleanup of v4.3.0 skill migration. v4.3.0: /bugfix migrated commands/ → skills/ per official docs. v4.2.x: SEC patches + thin entry-points. v4 base: orchestration in isolated controller agent.
